model_annotation: Figure 4 shows a heatmap of experimental results on the CCKS-IMLTC dataset for the PST framework under different positive-negative ratio combinations, where color intensity represents the F1 score. The x-axis, labeled "正例阈值" (positive threshold), ranges from 0.5 to 0.9 in increments of 0.1, and the y-axis, labeled "负例阈值" (negative threshold), ranges from 0.4 to 0.7 in increments of 0.1. The color scale on the right indicates F1 scores from 72 to 76, with cooler colors (blue-green) corresponding to lower scores and warmer colors (yellow) to higher scores. The data points are displayed as numerical values within each cell. The highest F1 score of 75.970 is observed at the intersection of a positive threshold of 0.7 and a negative threshold of 0.6. The highest score in the entire grid, 76.741, is found at the positive threshold of 0.7 and negative threshold of 0.5. The lowest F1 score shown, 71.285, is located at the positive threshold of 0.5 and negative threshold of 0.4.
